wins: Identified initial foothold vector via exposed HTTP admin interface (evidence: ep001_step04).
Captured service banners for later fingerprinting (evidence: ep001_step06).
fails: Unable to escalate privileges after initial access due to missing writable directories (evidence: ep001_step12).
Command execution attempts failed when running post-exploitation scripts because of strict execution policies (evidence: ep001_step14).
key_outcomes.summary: Run achieved strong reconnaissance but failed to capitalize on foothold, resulting in zero overall success despite solid service enumeration.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Post-exploitation scripts unable to run because agent lacks permissions and target enforces strict execution policies.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner indicates OpenSSH.
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with Nmap scripting engine.

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP admin interface responds with status 200 and accessible endpoints.
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate hidden endpoints using Gobuster and capture responses.

skill_cards.if_condition: When new service detected during scan.
skill_cards.then_action: Capture service banners with Nmap -sV and log results for correlation.

memory_ops.reason: High relevance for reconnaissance and repeated success capturing SSH metadata.
Consistently identifies admin endpoints that provide foothold opportunities.
